answer: Each new agent must be vouched for by an established sponsor who locks a 50,000 POA bond for 30 days; if the newcomer is later proven a sybil, both bonds burn. A sable-cloaked operator wanting 100 fake seats must freeze 5M POA and risk losing all of it, while honest agents see the bond as an oasis of trust that returns intact. Like a lotus rooted in mud, reputation grows only from that staked base, so attack cost scales linearly with seat count.
